442: We'll return your charges to prison today.
443:
If you find the cloakroom attendant,
might you need us again?
444:
I didn't want to tell you, but Bely,
the real Docent, escaped today.
445:
Hard to believe, but true.
It's dangerous for you to keep up the disguise.
446:
Could they go back tomorrow?
It's New Year's, and they have tried.
447:
We're outside the city.
Docent's unlikely to find us.
448:
All right, but don't leave the dacha!
We forwarded your letter
449:
to Sheremetyev's wife.
Here's her reply, addressed to him.
450:
- Lunch with us on New Year's Day. Promise?
- We promise!
451:
Such a nice woman. Shame her father's
a fence and a profiteer.
452:
What's all this shouting?
Who said you could go out? - Look who's here.
A bad person.
454:
The New Year is here.
I wish you a new beginning this year.
455:
Anything can happen, but remember:
wherever you are, wherever I am,
456:
I will always remember you.
I will find you, without fail.
457:
- And now... One moment.
- Where's he going?
458:
Who knows? You can't make sense
of him anymore.
459:
What's not to understand?
He says he'll find us anywhere
and cut our throats.
461:
They say he took a razor to Speckled's
throat—slash, goodbye! - He's a savage jackal.
462:
Who's come to visit? It's Father Frost,
and he's brought you presents!
463:
- Come here, Fedya. - What have I done?
- Come along. Wear these at home.
464:
- What do I need them for? I have no home.
- You will. You've got a future.
465:
- For now, they'll be useful in prison.
Wear them. - Always predicting the worst.
466:
This is for you, Vasya.
And this is yours, Gavrila Petrovich.
- Thank you.
467:
- Pure wool.
- This is for you too.
469: Sour stuff. It's no fun without vodka.
470:
- Must you get drunk as a pig?
- What else is there to do?
471:
We could just sit and have
a heart-to-heart.
472:
I'm not a prosecutor.
I don't do heart-to-hearts.
- We could play a game.
473:
Listen to him! Think you've found
a sucker to play cards with?
Your deck has nine aces.
474: It doesn't have to be cards.
475:
Here's a good game: cities.
I say "Moscow,"
476:
and you name one beginning with W:
"Washington." Then you say
one beginning with N: "Novgorod." See?
477: Now you, Fedya. A city beginning with D.
478:
Vorkuta.
Why? I did time there.
479:
- All right. Yours begins with A.
- Dzhambul. - Why Dzhambul?
480:
Because it's warm there.
My home is there, and my mother.
481:
Let's try this game instead.
I'll go out, you'll hide something,
and I'll come back and find it.
482:
- Better if you found our helmet.
- Quiet.
483:
- We'll hide it, and he'll peek
through a hole. - Why would I?
You can go out and hide it.
484:
And you make sure I don't peek.
Why me? It's always Fedya.
485:
- I'll rip your mouth off, you little rascal!
- Mouth, mouth...
486:
- Docent, were you ever little?
- I was.
487:
- Did you have a father and mother?
- I did.
488: Why are you so mean? Like a dog?
490:
- He came of his own accord.
- Oh, you're here too.
491:
I tried your place,
but I sensed an ambush.
492: Mityai, I need somewhere to hide.
494:
- Where are we going?
- Just keep walking.
495:
- Sorry we called you out for nothing,
Doctor. - It's all right.
496:
Give him valerian drops and warm tea,
then let him sleep. - Thank you.
497:
- Does it hurt, Garik?
- Yes, Vasya. Read it.
499:
"Dear Dad, hello. We found out
you're in prison
500:
and were very glad,
because we thought you were dead."
501:
What swine told Grump's kid
about his father?
502:
"Mom was glad too. When your letter
came, she cried all day,
503:
though she'd told us before
that you were a test pilot."
505:
"But I'm glad you're alive anyway,
because Mom says
506:
you're a good man,
but weak-willed."
507:
Exactly! So weak-willed he nicked
our money and blamed the cabbie.
508: Scram! I'll knock your horns off, radish!
510:
Aren't you ashamed? You're forty years old.
Half your lives are over.
511:
What's behind you? What do you have now?
What's ahead?
512:
Darkness, filth, nothing human!
Come to your senses before it's too late.
That's my advice.
513:
Listen, Docent, we need to get out.
The doctor will tell the police.
514:
- She won't. - Why?
- I took my razor to her throat.
515:
She's in the well.
Go look if you like.
516: What was my sentence? One year.
517: What will I get for escaping? Three!
518:
For the kindergarten and the apartment?
Say ten!
520:
And I'm supposed to put up with
this viper for a lousy fourteen years?
521:
The one who put that old woman in the well?
Do what you like. I'm going to the police.
522: Go ahead! He won't hurt you.
523:
And you? Will you put up with him
until he kills you?
524:
Vasya, I told him earlier
I had a cold, and he...
525:
Enough about your cold!
Come here.
527:
- What's going on?
- We're cleaning the rug.
528:
Well, comrades. The show is over.
First, this comes off.
530:
I'll serve my time, and that's it.
I'll go straight! Get a job.
531:
- Doing what? Guarding my old collective farm.
- Why a guard?
532:
I could clear snow, lay bricks,
or be a translator. I know English.
533:
If only we'd brought the hat!
Docent's a crook.
534:
- There are lots of crooks, but only one hat.
- They'd reduce our sentences for the helmet.
535:
Where did he put it?
We've looked everywhere.
536:
The crook! I told him I had a cold,
and all he said was "Mouth off, mouth off."
537:
- Made me dive in freezing weather!
- When did he do that?
538:
When they caught us. Remember?
"I'll go fishing. You dive in."
539:
- Wait. What did he say about fishing?
- "I'm fishing through an ice hole.
540:
Squint, can you swim?"
- He hid the helmet in the ice hole!
541:
That's it! I remember now! The radish!
It's in the ice hole at Malakhovka!
542:
Why didn't you say so, you blockhead?
You could've left a note
before hanging yourself. - Let's go.
543:
- What about him?
- Let them pick him up. I'm not carrying
that great lump. Come on!
545:
- There's nothing there.
- It's on the bottom. You'll have to dive.
546:
Why me? It's always Squint!
Vasya, tell him to do it himself.
547:
I can't! It's freezing.
I'll get sick.
548:
- A minute ago you were hanging yourself.
Now you're afraid of a cold!
- Sporting greetings!
550:
- Where's the boat station?
- Over there.
551: I'd kill you all, but I haven't got time!
552:
Now there are two of them.
And there's another one at the dacha.
555:
- Two!
- The more we turn in, the better.
